prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY the picnic composition in the user's attached videogame screenshot. Preserve exact original screenshot aspect ratio and framing, garden background, fence, tree design and its full roots, green vegetation wall platform, ground line, girl and fairy at left. The screenshot has a faulty floating picnic collage to the right of a large tree. Replace that picnic with a newly painted picnic that is convincingly RESTING ON THE SAME FLAT GRASS GROUND as the tree roots and the girl's shoes. Maintain the original hand-painted storybook game style, same teddy bear with teal bandana, green plush dinosaur, red toy robot and little red-green train, orange juice and toasted bread. Critical placement: completely to the RIGHT of the entire tree root/flower footprint, with a CLEAR VISIBLE STRIP OF GRASS between the tree's rightmost roots and the left edge of the blanket; no picnic object, teddy, food or blanket overlaps the tree roots, trunk, flowers, or foliage silhouette. Fit picnic within existing right frame by making its ensemble moderately more compact, never moving or shrinking the tree. CRITICAL GROUNDING: use a LOW SIDE VIEW with VERY SHALLOW foreshortening of the blanket, consistent with the platform game's grass ground line near y=610 in input. Blanket is a thin soft pale peach/cream/blue checked cloth, physically lying flat on the grass, front hem meeting the ground line, back hem only slightly higher on screen. NO large tilted floating trapezoid. No suspended rear edge, no raised stage. Teddy haunches and feet, dinosaur seated base and feet, robot seated feet and train wheels must all make direct contact with this same cloth. Strong tiny soft CONTACT shadows directly beneath each object's base, compressed grass and a few fine grass blades touching the blanket fringe, to convey weight. Plates, glasses and jug visibly rest on cloth with elliptical bases and localized contact shadows, no levitation or mismatch of perspective. Keep teddy/dinosaur/robot seated in a compact naturally spaced row, train on cloth beside them, two small plates of toasted bread and modest juice jug/glasses in front. All picnic elements share ONE ground plane; preserve readable identities and material details, not warped toys or tiny blurred icons. The entire ensemble may be slightly smaller and lower than the faulty one so all objects stay separate from the tree and within frame. Keep a small open grass gap at its left, retain tree and roots fully visible. No added borders, labels, UI, arrows, hitbox lines, extra objects or characters. Output single corrected screenshot example for user review; not a sprite sheet or a concept comparison.
estado: Amostra para validação humana. Perspectiva mais baixa, toalha sobre grama e conjunto separado das raízes. Nenhuma aplicação ao jogo nesta sessão.
